title: Identify a European compact root through the alternate constructor
changes: Record selector zero and the bounded projection for compact root 0x6c4910 through the alternate constructor path.
validation: Wine source query checked the caller, constructor and retained initializer/reader instructions against the EUR ROM; selector zero covers 162 nonoverlapping bytes, eight frames and six lists including an empty list.
limitations: Source evidence only: extraction, runtime use, ordinary reachability, other selectors, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. The two-byte gap stays raw; no performance measurements.
